name: Marketplace Profile
description: Professional profile for an accountant or accounting firm, shown by card-accountant.php and accountant-profile.php. One profile per Frappe User (app.edariba login identity); this is NOT the User record itself and does not duplicate auth/credential fields. 'verified'/'stats'/'reviews'/'ledger_id'/'membership'/'languages'/'hourly_rate'/'response_time' were already removed from the live UI in a prior pass and are intentionally not modeled.

fields.label: User
fields.description: The app.edariba login that owns this profile. One profile per user. Permlevel 1: hidden from Guest (public /api/resource reads); only System Manager and Marketplace Moderator see it.

fields.label: Profile Type
fields.description: Replaces the name-regex guess in edariba_mp_is_firm() (helpers.php) with an explicit field. card-service.php and card-accountant.php both branch rendering on firm-vs-individual (office icon, 'مكتب مهني مرخص' vs 'معتمد سجل المحاسبين').

fields.label: Slug
fields.description: Used to build the public profile URL (edariba_mp_url('accountant', $acc['slug'])).

fields.label: Headline
fields.description: e.g. 'مستشار ضرائب شركات ومحاسب قانوني'. Shown under the name on every card and the profile hero.

fields.label: Governorate
fields.description: Fixed list copied from Dummy_Data_Provider::governorates(). Plain Select (not a Link taxonomy) because the list is small, stable, and only ever used for this one filter today -- add options here if more governorates are needed, no new DocType required.

fields.label: Area / District
fields.description: Free text, e.g. 'مدينة نصر والتجمع'. Combined with governorate for display as 'location' at the presentation layer; not stored redundantly here.

fields.label: Bio
fields.description: Professional bio paragraph shown in the 'overview' section of the profile page.

fields.label: Offers Services
fields.description: Accountant side: lists services and receives requests from clients.

fields.label: Accepts Projects
fields.description: Freelancer side: can send proposals on posted projects.

fields.label: Verification Status
fields.description: Moderation decision. Only a moderator can change it (controller guard); the owner never can. A profile must be Verified before it can be published. Permlevel 1: hidden from Guest (public /api/resource reads); only System Manager and Marketplace Moderator see it.
